We asked Pam Bondi about Ghislaine Maxwell's prison transfer. She claimed not to know about it and instead placed blame on Acting AG Todd Blanche and the Bureau of Prisons.

We have a lot more questions, especially for Mr. Blanche, and Republicans should join us in asking them.

Video

Ms. Bondi, you said “Blanche was managing the entire investigation” and you said he was responsible for redactions that exposed survivors. You deflected to him over 30 times.

We think Chairman Comer should have videotaped this, don’t you agree?

I asked the Former AG multiple times about her conversations with President Trump: what he knew, what he told her to do, and she refused to answer ANY questions about the President.

She refused over and over again to answer any questions about Trump. Why?

Video

No more lies. No more cover-ups.

It’s time for Pam Bondi to answer our questions.

Video

There is no reason we should not videotape Pam Bondi's interview. This is an important moment for the Epstein investigation, and she has a lot to answer for.

Republicans videotaped and released other interviews, so why not this one? Stop the White House cover-up.
